script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

Title: A Second Chance at Life

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

*FRANK, 50s, a disheveled, overweight man in a stained apron, pours himself a bowl of cereal.*

FRANK:
(sighs, looking at the box)
Another day, another bowl.

Suddenly, his phone rings. He picks it up.

FRANK:
(excited)
Hey, Lily! How did the job interview go?

INT. LIVING ROOM - CONTEMPORARY APARTMENT

*LILY, 20s, a determined young woman with glasses, sits on a plush chair, biting her lower lip.*

LILY:
(nervous)
It didn't go well, Frank. I didn't get the job.

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

FRANK:
(disappointed)
Oh, Lily. I'm really sorry.

INT. LIVING ROOM - CONTEMPORARY APARTMENT

LILY:
(tearfully)
I don't know what I'm going to do now, Frank. I thought this was my chance.

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

FRANK:
(sympathetic)
Well, maybe it's not over yet. Maybe you just need a little push.

INT. FRANK'S GARAGE - DAY

*Frank rummages through old boxes and finds an old, beat-up RV. He looks it over, assessing its condition.*

INT. FRANK'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

*Frank calls Lily.*

FRANK:
(excited)
Lily, I've got an idea. What do you think about a road trip? I've found this old RV, and I thought we could travel the country and look for opportunities.

INT. LIVING ROOM - CONTEMPORARY APARTMENT - NIGHT

LILY:
(surprised)
Really? That sounds amazing, Frank!

INT. FRANK'S APARTMENT - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

*The two pack essentials and plan their route, their faces filled with excitement and hope.*

INT. RV PARKING LOT - DAY

*The RV, now cleaned up and filled with supplies, pulls into a beautiful RV park overlooking a lake.*

INT. RV - LIVING ROOM - EVENING

*Frank and Lily sit on the couch, looking out the window at the sunset.*

FRANK:
You know, Lily, this might be exactly what we both need. A new start, a second chance.

LILY:
(smiling)
Yes, Frank. I think you're right.

INT. RV - KITCHEN - NIGHT

*The two cook dinner together, laughing and joking, their spirits lifted.*

INT. RV - BEDROOM - NIGHT

*They lay in bed, looking up at the stars through the roof.*

LILY:
(whispering)
Frank, I'm so glad we did this. I have a feeling things are going to be different this time around.

FRANK:
(smiling)
I agree, Lily. I believe we're going to make the most of this second chance at life.

Fade out.

End of screenplay.
